LanguageData.JobSplitterModWarning: For any changed settings to take effect the game must be restarted.
LanguageData.JobSplitterSurgeonWorktypeTooltip: Moves surgery related tasks to their own worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterNursingWorktypeTooltip: Moves feeding, visiting and moving patients to their own worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterNursingPrisonersTooltip: Moves feeding prisoners to the Nursing worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterNursingBabiesTooltip: Moves all baby related tasks to the Nursing worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterTeachingWorktypeTooltip: Moves teaching children to its own worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterRearmingWorktypeTooltip: Moves rearming traps and refueling buildings to their own worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterRearmingRechargeTooltip: Adds hauling mechanoids to charging stations to the Rearming Worktype. (Haulers will still perform this task)
LanguageData.JobSplitterRecruitingWorktypeTooltip: Moves chatting with prisoners to its own worktype. (Will also convert and enslave prisoners if Ideology is enabled)
LanguageData.JobSplitterTrainingWorktypeTooltip: Moves training animals to its own worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterTamingWorktypeTooltip: Moves taming animals to its own worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterButcheringWorktypeTooltip: Moves butchering related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterButcheringSlaughterTooltip: Adds slaughtering animals to the Butchering Worktype. (Handlers will still perform this task)
LanguageData.JobSplitterButcheringExecutionTooltip: Adds prisoner execution to the Butchering Worktype. (Wardens will still perform this task)
LanguageData.JobSplitterBrewingWorktypeTooltip: Moves brewing related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterRepairingWorktypeTooltip: Moves repairing related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterDemolishingWorktypeTooltip: Moves demolition related tasks to their own Worktype. (Construct will still build roofs and deconstruct things underneath blueprints)
LanguageData.JobSplitterHarvestingWorktypeTooltip: Moves plant harvesting related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterDrillingWorktypeTooltip: Moves drilling related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterFabricatingWorktypeTooltip: Moves fabrication bench related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterDrugsWorktypeTooltip: Moves drug lab related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterRefiningWorktypeTooltip: Moves chemical refining tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterStonecuttingWorktypeTooltip: Moves stonecutting tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterSmeltingWorktypeTooltip: Moves smelting tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterLoadingWorktypeTooltip: Moves caravan loading related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterMortifyingWorktypeTooltip: Moves corpse and cremation related tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterDeliveringWorktypeTooltip: Moves delivering materials to blueprints tasks to their own Worktype.
LanguageData.JobSplitterScanningWorktypeTooltip: Moves scanning tasks to their own Worktype.
